the-cop-who-wasnt.title: I heard someone picking the lock of the motel room next to mine
the-cop-who-wasnt.description: I was two doors down from a man working the locks of motel rooms with a piece of wire. I dragged a dresser against my door and climbed out the bathroom window to the office. They found him in another room the next week. #truehorror #reallifehorror #ScaryTales

the-refrigerator-truck.title: My manager locked me inside a refrigerated trailer and walked away
the-refrigerator-truck.description: I was unloading a refrigerated trailer when the doors slammed shut behind me and the locking bar was thrown home. I watched my manager walk away with the keys. The emergency release was the only thing that saved me. #reallifehorror #creepyencounter #ScaryTales

the-smoke-detector-camera.title: I found a hidden camera in the smoke detector of my rental
the-smoke-detector-camera.description: A tiny dark spot on the smoke detector of my rental, facing the bed, with a green blink at night. On day two I pulled the cover off and found a lens and a battery pack. The listing photos showed a different detector. I packed and left. #reallifehorror #creepyencounter #ScaryTales

the-fake-rideshare-driver.title: A fake rideshare driver knew my name at the airport
the-fake-rideshare-driver.description: My plane landed at midnight and a black sedan rolled up before my app said my driver was near. The man inside said my name - then told me to get in. One wrong word tipped me off. I walked back toward the terminal. #reallifehorror #truehorror #ScaryTales
